'''Glor Jal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] union leader in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City's]] [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]]. Jal was known to be corrupt and had a weakness for [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Lum/Legends|lum]].
